messages:
Ava (AE): Skyline Health asked for a perf validation that mirrors their edge setup: TLS at edge, customer KMS (HSM), and strict p95 SLA for clinician queries <=300ms at seq=384. Can we run a focused POC next Tue? cc @Drew
Drew (Solutions Eng): Yes. Quick test plan: dedicated pool in us-east-2, model=redwood-v2-medium, seq=384. Cases: 1) warmed cache + fp16 + cached-envelope KMS; 2) warmed + int8 + cached-envelope; 3) warmed + int8 + per-request HSM unwrap; 4) cold-cache baseline. Warmup 6k requests, steady for 10m at 160 QPS. Capture p50/p95/p99, token latency breakdown, HSM histograms, and error traces.
Samir (ML Eng): Use Skyline's anonymized clinical prompt set (shared bucket). For int8 run both static and optimized kernels; often int8 lowers median but can widen tail. Include streaming vs non-streaming comparison for interactive flows.
Jon (SRE): I'll provision pool and pin nodes to avoid GC overlap. Need Skyline CIDRs and KMS cert. Deploy snippet I'll use:
```
helm upgrade --install skyline-perf ./charts/dedicated \ 
  --set model.name=redwood-v2-medium \ 
  --set tls.enabled=true --set tls.mode=passthrough \ 
  --set kms.provider=hsm --set autoscale.min=3 --set autoscale.max=8
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: redwood/dedicated/skyline-perf @2177777790
Priyanka (Security - Skyline Health): We can provide certs and CIDRs. Our compliance team may require per-request HSM for some endpoints; procurement needs cost delta.
Drew (Solutions Eng): We'll run both KMS modes and produce side-by-side latency + cost numbers. Expect ~1-2ms overhead for cached envelope, ~6-9ms for per-request unwrap.
deploy-bot: smoke run complete @2177777798
Jon (SRE): Smoke summary (cached-envelope + int8 streaming, seq=384, 160QPS, 10m):
- p50: 58ms
- p95: 175ms
- p99: 360ms
- error_rate: 0.08% (transient timeouts during a node GC spike)
- observed HSM overhead (cached): median 1.7ms, p95 4.1ms
Samir (ML Eng): Median and p95 look solid for interactive. p99 at 360ms is above the 300ms p95 SLA but p99 is expected to be higher. For per-request unwrap we saw p99 jump to ~520ms on a couple hosts. Next steps: enable aggressive prefix warming, increase pool to 8 nodes, and rerun with int8 + fp16 A/B to reduce tail.
Ava (AE): I'll share these numbers with Priyanka and flag the pricing impact. If Skyline requires per-request HSM, finance estimate is ~0.11-0.14/request uplift for Dedicated. cc @Finance.
Priyanka (Security - Skyline Health): Thanks. We'll confirm compliance constraints by EOD Mon. If cached-envelope meets compliance, procurement prefers that. Please run the follow-up with pool=8 and aggressive warming Thu 09:00 ET.
Drew (Solutions Eng): Follow-up scheduled Thu 09:00 ET. I'll post the load generator commands and attach flamegraphs/traces if tail persists.
Jon (SRE): I'll collect per-host GC logs and HSM latency traces and extend observability retention 48h for this run.
Ava (AE): Great work team ":thumbsup:"
